verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents a versioned (v8) public REST API. It covers CRUD on module records, metadata discovery, COQL queries, composite and bulk calls, notification channels, per-module OAuth scopes and credit-based rate limits, and official Python and Node SDKs. Together this lets a programmatic or AI-driven client operate the product end to end. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, and a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probes at the standard OpenAPI paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Perform CRUD operations on CRM module entities and integrate with any third party application through flexible RESTful endpoints.
Fetch the metadata of modules, fields, layouts, custom views, and related lists.
To add new entities or records in a module. You can insert up to 100 records in a single API call.
CRM Object Query Language(COQL) uses the SELECT query to fetch records from Zoho CRM. This API follows the SQL syntax.
This API allows you to insert, update, or upsert a maximum of 25000 records in a single API call.
Separate scopes are used to provide access to data in a particular module without access to other modules.
